entities.name: Chiesa del Sacro Cuore del Suffragio
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Sacro Cuore di Gesù in Prati, also known as Sacro Cuore del Suffragio, is a Catholic church in the centre of Rome (Italy), rising in the rione Prati, hosting the parish with the same name, entrusted to the Missionaries of the Sacred Heart.
